    L["A rule published years before it applies"] -->|"is a field, a clock or a document"| K["Regulatory calendar: system of record, test, owner and date per row"]

    M --> O
    K --> O

flowchart LR
    S["Product page: a lawful was-price and a manufacturer address"] --> C["Checkout: the prescribed button, a session, a challenge for the script"]
    C --> Y["Payment: the card number goes to the payment provider, never to the merchant"]
    Y --> F["Fulfillment: name and address to the WMS, the carrier and the ERP, each on its own clock"]
    F --> X["Exchange request, 19 April: two 14-day clocks start"]
    X --> D["Later: a deletion request that must reach every copy within a month"]
